Behind the projects

Built by a diver.

RunTime Dive Systems is a home for the tools and ideas Josh is developing around technical diving.

From a practical problem to a project.

Route planning, gas labels, organizing a dive group, and building something useful on the workbench. Each project starts with a part of diving that could work a little better.

RunTime brings those projects together, with space to document the development and share what comes next.

Pacific Northwest, above and below.

Cold-water diving, wrecks, giant Pacific octopuses, and sixgill sharks shape the visual world of this site. The chart lines and marine-life artwork are a nod to those waters.
